name: Data.gov Catalog API
known_limitations: The catalog is a metadata discovery rail, not the underlying evidence. FTFN claims still require selecting the responsible source owner, dataset, update date, and data-quality notes.
jurisdiction: United States federal, state, local, tribal, and public-sector catalog metadata
automation_notes: Use as a source-of-sources for watch-lane keyword searches. Promote discovered datasets separately before using them in signals.
